axis.source: fitted to OHM's Neue Wilhelmstraße standing in 1917 (279 of 289 points every metre within 2.5 m), pointing south; stations in metres along u (south) from the Unter den Linden crossing, the Reichstagufer at -280 (tools/addr/axis.ts)

first_side: numbers 1-8a go south down the west side from the Reichstagufer to Unter den Linden (8a is Unter den Linden 76a); 8b-16 come back north up the east side
corners_source: the openings in the 1917 fronts: the Reichstagufer quay north of -272, Dorotheenstraße -190, Unter den Linden 0
